rationale: Louan brings deep expertise in applied ML pipelines and medical imaging—domains where robust, production-grade AI is critical—while Jamie is scaling agentic AI to automate complex, repetitive workflows at Mastt. Though their verticals differ, Jamie's conviction that AI should solve real problems over generating ideas aligns with Louan's focus on clinically-grounded neuroimaging ML, and there may be interesting cross-pollination on how self-supervised learning and automation principles could apply to construction project workflows.
intro_message: Louan, meet Jamie Cerexhe, CTO and co-founder of Mastt—he's building agentic AI for construction at scale and might offer insights on deploying ML pipelines in high-stakes, real-world settings similar to what you're doing in clinical neuroimaging.
